BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald are delighted to present No 5 Somerton Drive, an exceptional A-rated family home ideally positioned within the newest phase of Somerton, one of Lucan's most prestigious and sought-after residential developments. Combining contemporary design, outstanding energy efficiency and impeccable presentation, this remarkable property offers a rare opportunity to acquire a truly turnkey home in a prime family-friendly setting.
Boasting an impressive A2 BER rating, the property has been thoughtfully designed to deliver maximum comfort, efficiency and sustainability. High-performance glazing, an air-to-water heat pump system, responsive mechanical ventilation and superior insulation work seamlessly together to create an energy-efficient home with reduced running costs and year-round comfort.
Presented in pristine condition throughout, No. 5 has been meticulously maintained and enhanced by its current owners, resulting in a home of genuine quality and style. A sophisticated palette of warm, neutral tones flows effortlessly from room to room, complemented by elegant wide-plank flooring on the ground floor and luxurious carpeting at first-floor level. The bathrooms, including the en-suite and guest WC, are beautifully finished with contemporary porcelain tiling, adding a touch of understated luxury throughout.
The accommodation has been carefully designed to meet the demands of modern family living. At the heart of the home is a stunning open-plan kitchen and dining area. Fitted with sleek contemporary cabinetry and generous workspace, this bright and inviting space is perfect for both everyday family life and entertaining guests. Just off the kitchen, a practical utility room provides additional storage and convenience, while glazed patio doors open directly onto the beautifully landscaped rear garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.
To the front, the spacious living room is flooded with natural light through a large picture window and provides an elegant yet comfortable setting in which to relax and unwind. A contemporary guest WC and a cleverly designed under-stair office hub complete the ground floor accommodation.
Upstairs, the exceptional standard of finish continues. There are three generously proportioned bedrooms, including a bright and beautifully appointed main bedroom complete with a stylish en-suite bathroom. A contemporary family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms, while a large walk-in storage room offers excellent practicality and additional space rarely found in modern homes.
A substantial attic further enhances the home's appeal, offering outstanding potential for conversion, subject to the necessary permissions. Whether utilised as a home office, gym, hobby room, cinema room or additional accommodation, the possibilities are extensive.
Externally, the property is equally impressive. A neat cobblelock driveway to the front provides convenient off-street parking and is framed by attractive mature planting. To the rear lies a beautifully landscaped private garden, thoughtfully designed to maximise enjoyment throughout the seasons. A well-maintained lawn is complemented by raised flower beds and a superb, elevated patio area, complete with an enclosed pergola that creates a wonderful outdoor extension of the home. Whether enjoying al fresco dining on a summer evening, entertaining family and friends, or simply relaxing with a morning coffee on a rainy day, this exceptional outdoor space offers a perfect retreat all year round. A garden shed provides valuable additional storage.
The location is second to none. Somerton has established itself as one of Lucan's most desirable addresses, renowned for its attractive streetscapes, family-friendly atmosphere and exceptional convenience. Residents enjoy immediate access to a wealth of local amenities, including the nearby SuperValu Shopping Centre, cafés, restaurants, parks, playgrounds and a range of sports clubs and recreational facilities.
Families are particularly well catered for, with an excellent selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools located within easy reach, while numerous green spaces and sporting amenities provide an enviable lifestyle for growing families.
For commuters, the convenience on offer is outstanding. Adamstown Train Station is just minutes away, providing frequent services to Dublin City Centre, while the N4, M50 and extensive public transport network ensure seamless access to Dublin City, Dublin Airport and beyond. Lucan Village, with its vibrant selection of cafés, restaurants, boutique shops and picturesque village atmosphere, is also within easy reach, offering the perfect blend of suburban tranquillity and urban convenience.
No. 5 Somerton Drive represents a superb opportunity to acquire an impeccably presented, energy-efficient family home in one of West Dublin's most sought-after residential locations. Combining stylish contemporary interiors, beautifully landscaped outdoor space and unrivalled convenience, this outstanding property is certain to appeal to a wide range of discerning purchasers seeking a home of true distinction.

Entrance Hall - 4.59m x 1.95m
A bright, spacious and welcoming entrance hall sets the tone for the quality found throughout the home. Finished with stylish wide-plank laminate flooring, this impressive space offers a warm first impression while providing seamless access to the principal living accommodation.

Open-Plan Kitchen / Living / Dining Room - 9.21m x 3.75m
Undoubtedly the heart of the home, this exceptional open-plan kitchen, living and dining area extends the full length of the property, creating a superb sense of space, light and flow. To the front, an elegant yet inviting living area is centred around a large picture window that floods the room with natural light, while wide-plank laminate flooring enhances the feeling of continuity throughout.To the rear, the contemporary kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with both style and functionality in mind, boasting an extensive range of premium base and eye-level units, generous countertop workspace and a selection of high-quality integrated appliances. The dining area effortlessly connects the living and kitchen spaces, making it an ideal setting for both everyday family life and entertaining guests.

Home Office Hub - 1.79m x 0.75m
Cleverly positioned beneath the staircase, this bespoke home office hub provides a practical and private workspace, perfectly suited to modern-day living and remote working requirements.

Guest WC - 1.90m x 1.44m
A spacious and tastefully appointed guest WC featuring tiled flooring, WC, WHB and a wall-mounted mirror.

Bedroom 1 - 3.67m x 3.55m
A generously proportioned and beautifully presented double bedroom positioned to the front of the property. This impressive main suite benefits from floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes, plush carpet flooring and a contemporary en-suite bathroom.

En-Suite - 2.35m x 1.50m
A stylish and well-appointed en-suite featuring quality tiled flooring, WHB, WC with concealed cistern, wall-mounted mirror, heated towel rail and a spacious walk-in shower complete with pump shower.

Bedroom 2 - 3.93m x 3.01m
A spacious double bedroom located to the rear of the property, overlooking the private garden. This bright and comfortable room benefits from carpet flooring and a fitted wardrobe, providing excellent storage solutions.

Bedroom 3 - 2.72m x 2.68m
A well-proportioned single bedroom positioned to the rear of the property, finished with carpet flooring and ideally suited as a child's bedroom, guest room or additional home office.

Family Bathroom - 2.37m x 2.00m
An impressive and generously sized family bathroom, finished to a high standard and comprising a WC with concealed cistern, WHB, wall-mounted mirror, heated towel rail and a bath with overhead pump shower, creating a luxurious and practical space for everyday use.
